title: The Vine and the Little Ones
old_p1: Jonah was not happy that Heavenly Father kept Nineveh safe. The people of Nineveh had been enemies of his people, and Jonah had wanted them punished.
So Jonah sat outside the city in the hot sun. Heavenly Father made a gourd vine, a big leafy plant, grow up over him for shade. Jonah was very glad.
old_p2: The next morning a worm chewed the vine, and it dried up. Jonah was upset.

Heavenly Father said, “You cared about a vine you did not even grow. Should I not care about Nineveh?” It had more than 120,000 people who did not know their right hand from their left, and lots of cows too.
That means they still had so much to learn. Heavenly Father loves every person, and He loves you. Feel that big love tonight.
p1: Jonah was angry that Heavenly Father saved Nineveh, his people’s enemies. He had wanted them punished.
Jonah sat outside the city. Heavenly Father made a leafy vine grow over him, shady like an umbrella.
The next morning, Heavenly Father sent a worm. The worm chewed the vine, and it dried up. The hot sun beat down, and Jonah was upset.
p2: Heavenly Father said, “You cared about this vine. You did not make it grow. Should I not care about Nineveh?” Nineveh had more than 120,000 people who could not tell right from left. They were like little children, still learning.
Heavenly Father loves everyone, even people hard to love. Tonight, think of someone hard to be kind to. Ask Him to help you love them.
